---
title: "NHS Scotland Waiting Times"
---

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// Pre-aggregated data, written by pipeline/build-data.R at build time.
data = FileAttachment("data/waiting_profile.json").json()

// Selector option lists, derived from the data
boards = Array.from(new Set(data.map(d => d.hb))).sort()
ptypes = Array.from(new Set(data.map(d => d.ptype))).sort()
specs  = ["All", ...Array.from(new Set(data.filter(d => d.spec !== "All").map(d => d.spec))).sort()]

fmtMonth = d => d.toLocaleDateString("en-GB", { month: "long", year: "numeric" })
fmtNum   = n => n == null ? "—" : Math.round(n).toLocaleString("en-GB")
```

## {.sidebar}

```{ojs}
viewof hb = Inputs.select(boards, {
  label: "Health Board",
  value: boards.includes("Scotland") ? "Scotland" : boards[0]
})
viewof ptype = Inputs.select(ptypes, { label: "Patient Type" })
viewof spec = Inputs.select(specs, { label: "Specialty", value: "All" })
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// Apply the current selection (pure filtering — no aggregation needed)
filtered = data
  .filter(d => d.hb === hb && d.ptype === ptype && d.spec === spec)
  .map(d => ({ ...d, date: new Date(d.date), total: d.w1 + d.w2 + d.w3 + d.w4 }))
  .sort((a, b) => a.date - b.date)

latest = filtered.length ? filtered[filtered.length - 1] : null

// Long-format data for the stacked breakdown chart (defined here, not in the
// card block, so each chart card holds a single Plot expression)
bandOrder = ["0–26 weeks", "26–52 weeks", "52–78 weeks", "Over 78 weeks"]

bands = filtered.flatMap(d => [
  { date: d.date, band: "0–26 weeks",    value: d.w1 },
  { date: d.date, band: "26–52 weeks",   value: d.w2 },
  { date: d.date, band: "52–78 weeks",   value: d.w3 },
  { date: d.date, band: "Over 78 weeks", value: d.w4 }
])
```

```{ojs}
      ].join("\n")
    }))
```

# Balance

```{ojs}
//| output: false
balanceData = FileAttachment("data/balance.json").json()

balanceFiltered = balanceData
  .filter(d => d.hb === hb && d.ptype === ptype && d.spec === spec)
  .map(d => ({ ...d, date: new Date(d.date) }))
  .sort((a, b) => a.date - b.date)

balanceLatest = balanceFiltered.length ? balanceFiltered[balanceFiltered.length - 1] : null

fmtQuarter = d => `${d.getFullYear()} Q${Math.floor(d.getMonth() / 3) + 1}`

// Additions / removals in long form for a two-series line chart
addRem = balanceFiltered.flatMap(d => [
  { date: d.date, series: "Additions", value: d.add },
  { date: d.date, series: "Removals", value: d.rem }
])

reasonOrder = ["Attended", "Referred", "Transferred", "No Treatment", "Other"]

// Removal reasons as a share of total removals (sums to 100% each quarter)
reasons = balanceFiltered.flatMap(d => {
  const parts = { Attended: d.attended, Referred: d.referred, Transferred: d.transferred, "No Treatment": d.notreat, Other: d.other }
  const sum = reasonOrder.reduce((a, r) => a + (parts[r] || 0), 0)
  return reasonOrder.map(r => ({ date: d.date, reason: r, pct: sum ? (parts[r] || 0) / sum * 100 : 0 }))
})
```

```{ojs}
  </div>
  <div class="stat-card primary">

  <div class="stat-card ${balanceLatest && balanceLatest.bal > 0 ? "danger" : "success"}">

    <div class="stat-value">${balanceLatest ? fmtNum(balanceLatest.bal) : "—"}</div>
    <div class="stat-sub">${balanceLatest ? fmtQuarter(balanceLatest.date) : ""}</div>
  </div>
</div>`
```

```{ojs}
//| title: Reasons for Removal from Waiting List
Plot.plot({
  height: 500,
  marginLeft: 70,
  x: { label: null },
  y: { grid: true, label: "Percentage of Removals", domain: [0, 100], tickFormat: d => d + "%" },
  color: { legend: true, domain: reasonOrder, range: ["#0078D4", "#42A5F5", "#90CAF9", "#1976D2", "#0D47A1"] },
  marks: [
    Plot.areaY(reasons, { x: "date", y: "pct", fill: "reason", order: reasonOrder }),
    Plot.ruleY([0]),
    Plot.tip(balanceFiltered, Plot.pointerX({
      x: "date",
      y: () => 100,
      title: d => {
        const parts = { Attended: d.attended, Referred: d.referred, Transferred: d.transferred, "No Treatment": d.notreat, Other: d.other }
        const sum = reasonOrder.reduce((a, r) => a + (parts[r] || 0), 0)
        return [fmtQuarter(d.date), ...reasonOrder.map(r => `${r}: ${sum ? ((parts[r] || 0) / sum * 100).toFixed(1) : 0}%`)].join("\n")
      }
    }))
  ]
})
```

# 12-Week Target

```{ojs}
//| output: false
target12Data = FileAttachment("data/target12.json").json()

t12Filtered = target12Data
  .filter(d => d.hb === hb && d.ptype === ptype && d.spec === spec)
  .map(d => ({ ...d, date: new Date(d.date) }))
  .sort((a, b) => a.date - b.date)

t12Latest = t12Filtered.length ? t12Filtered[t12Filtered.length - 1] : null
t12Pct = t12Latest && t12Latest.seen ? t12Latest.within12 / t12Latest.seen * 100 : null
t12Theme = t12Pct == null ? "primary" : t12Pct >= 95 ? "success" : t12Pct >= 80 ? "warning" : "danger"

treatedSeries = ["Within 12 weeks", "Over 12 weeks"]

treatedLong = t12Filtered.flatMap(d => [
  { date: d.date, series: "Within 12 weeks", value: d.within12 },
  { date: d.date, series: "Over 12 weeks", value: d.over12 }
])

pctLong = t12Filtered.flatMap(d => {
  const tot = d.seen || 0
  return [
    { date: d.date, series: "Within 12 weeks", pct: tot ? d.within12 / tot * 100 : 0 },
    { date: d.date, series: "Over 12 weeks", pct: tot ? d.over12 / tot * 100 : 0 }
  ]
})

waitLong = t12Filtered.flatMap(d => [
  { date: d.date, metric: "Median", value: d.median },
  { date: d.date, metric: "90th percentile", value: d.p90 }
])
```

## Row {height="160px"}

```{ojs}
html`<div class="stat-grid">
  <div class="stat-card ${t12Theme}">
    <div class="stat-label">Seen Within 12 Weeks</div>
    <div class="stat-value">${t12Pct == null ? "—" : t12Pct.toFixed(1) + "%"}</div>
    <div class="stat-sub">${t12Latest ? fmtQuarter(t12Latest.date) : ""}</div>
  </div>
  <div class="stat-card danger">
    <div class="stat-label">Waiting Over 12 Weeks</div>
    <div class="stat-value">${t12Latest ? fmtNum(t12Latest.over12) : "—"}</div>
    <div class="stat-sub">${t12Latest ? fmtQuarter(t12Latest.date) : ""}</div>
  </div>
</div>`
```

# Diagnostic Waits

```{ojs}
//| output: false
diagData = FileAttachment("data/diagnostics.json").json()

diagGroups = ["0 to 4 weeks", "4 to 8 weeks", "8 to 18 weeks", "4 to 12 months", "Over 1 year", "Other"]

diagTypes = Array.from(new Set(diagData.map(d => d.type))).sort()

// Descriptions available for the selected test type (cascading selector)
diagDescs = Array.from(new Set(diagData.filter(d => d.type === diagType).map(d => d.desc))).sort()

diagFiltered = diagData
  .filter(d => d.hb === hb && d.type === diagType && d.desc === diagDesc)
  .map(d => ({ ...d, date: new Date(d.date) }))

// One row per month with each band's value, for stacking tooltips + totals
diagByMonth = Array.from(d3.group(diagFiltered, d => +d.date), ([t, rows]) => {
  const date = new Date(t)
  const m = {}; diagGroups.forEach(g => m[g] = 0)
  let total = 0; rows.forEach(r => { m[r.grp] = (m[r.grp] || 0) + r.n; total += r.n })
  return { date, total, ...m }
}).sort((a, b) => a.date - b.date)

diagLatest = diagByMonth.length ? diagByMonth[diagByMonth.length - 1] : null
```

```{ojs}

```

```{ojs}
  color: {

      ].join("\n")
    }))
  ]
})
```
